hook: A platform records voltage from about 1,500 engineered human neurons at once.

readout.label: Neurons recorded at 800 Hz per field

summary: The team built a stem cell line that turns into neurons, accepts gene knockdowns, and carries light-based voltage sensors and actuators. A wide-field microscope then records about 1,500 firing neurons at once. Knocking down five ion-channel genes gave distinct firing signatures. Only five genes were tested, so the platform's reach across the genome is still to be shown.
title: A high-throughput all-optical platform for mapping gene perturbations to electrophysiology
